# Check Libs

See [C++ Library Headers & CMake Config Files](https://frinring.wordpress.com/2026/06/30/c-library-headers-cmake-config-files-are-we-serviceable/)

## Execute tests

```bash
ninja install

ninja all_installed_library_check

or

cmake --preset all_installed_library_check
cmake --build --preset all_installed_library_check
```
